My dog ​​had a crooked front paw spur and the nail was almost broken. The dog was sedated and the nail was cut at the base (it did not require complete removal). During the procedure, the other nails were also cut. This was not agreed with the owner. At home, I noticed that three nails had been cut down to the flesh. This was not mentioned to me during the appointment. I later went back and complained that this should not have happened and why nothing was said about this. I received an apology and that was all (I hear this is sometimes unfortunately the case). It's a shame, this was my first time at this clinic and I still have a bad feeling. The "nail treatment" cost €272. I don't recommend it.
